Bringing over 5 years of deep real estate and field operations experience within the Keller Williams network, he bridges the gap between advanced technology and real-world property dynamics. about.leadership.yagiz.bio: Yağız is a Senior Software Architect and Systems Engineer specialized in building high-performance GenAI infrastructure, native data retrieval pipelines, and scalable distributed systems from scratch. Having architected and launched over 150 production systems spanning high-throughput web topologies and financial transactional pipelines, he serves as the core system architect behind Reservatior. At Reservatior, Yağız engineered the enterprise-grade workflow engine from the ground up, utilizing custom task-queue schedulers and close-to-metal kernels to maintain sub-millisecond invocation overhead under heavy multi-tenant scale.
about.mission.p1: Reservatior was founded to redefine modern hospitality and property management through high-performance, enterprise-grade technology. Focusing on the high-density, multi-tenant property landscape of Seattle, we optimize regional real-time data structures and streamline complex transactional workflows.
about.mission.p2: By integrating Amazon API-driven furniture staging infrastructure with a low-latency SaaS engine, Reservatior bridges the gap between complex infrastructure engineering and seamless, localized operations. Our mission is to empower property managers to maximize yield, automate deployment, and scale multi-tenant portfolios with mathematical precision.

about.title: 关于我们
about.subtitle: 我们的故事与使命
about.mission.p1: Reservatior 的创立旨在通过高性能的企业级技术重新定义现代酒店和物业管理。我们聚焦西雅图高密度、多租户的房地产格局，优化区域实时数据结构并简化复杂的交易工作流程。
about.mission.p2: 通过将亚马逊API驱动的家具布置基础设施与低延迟SaaS引擎相结合，Reservatior 弥合了复杂基础设施工程与无缝本地运营之间的差距。我们的使命是让物业管理者最大化收益、自动化部署并以数学精度扩展多租户投资组合。
about.leadership.title: 我们的领导团队
about.leadership.yagiz.role: 创始人兼首席AI系统架构师
about.leadership.yagiz.bio: Yağız 是高级软件架构师和系统工程师，专门从零构建高性能 GenAI 基础设施、原生数据检索管道和可扩展的分布式系统。他设计并上线了超过150个生产系统，是 Reservatior 的核心系统架构师。
about.leadership.lance.role: 联合创始人兼房地产运营主管
about.leadership.lance.bio: Lance 直接在西雅图负责 Reservatior 的本地化执行、房产收购和投资组合管理策略。凭借在 Keller Williams 网络内超过5年的房地产和现场运营经验，他弥合了先进技术与现实房产动态之间的差距。

about.why.api.desc: 自动化布置解决方案，将房产布局与可扩展的家具部署基础设施动态同步。
